title: Fried Turkey Wings
description: These fried turkey wings, seasoned with garlic and cayenne, are deep fried until crispy outside and juicy inside for a delicious way to enjoy turkey.
ingredients: 2 turkey wings, cut apart at joints and wing tips discarded
1 teaspoon seafood seasoning (such as Old Bay®)
4 quarts canola oil for deep frying

steps.text: Season turkey wing pieces on all sides with seasoned salt, seafood seasoning, cayenne pepper, and garlic powder. Transfer into a resealable plastic bag; seal bag and marinate in the refrigerator for 4 hours to overnight.
Heat oil in a deep-fryer or large saucepan to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

Cook turkey wings in hot oil for 15 minutes; turn wings over and continue cooking until the meat is no longer pink at the bone, 10 to 15 minutes. An instant-read thermometer inserted near the bone should read 165 degrees F (74 degrees C).
